properties.selection_rationale: Basaltic volcanic terrain used by NASA's BASALT field campaigns (Lim et al. 2019). The window covers the northern lava field and cinder-cone area; it is not claimed to coincide with specific BASALT sample sites.
known_limitations: Region-level BASALT research does not validate this exact window
Basalt composition and vesicularity are not measured by the terrain index
National monument rules govern access; not assessed here
properties.creation_method: Geodetic display footprint approximated from a 10 km square; processing constructs an exact UTM metric grid around the centre.
properties.planetary_target: The registered 10 km Jezero reference window under terrain-only comparison.
properties.representativeness: Feature-focused window; it does not represent the whole region.
properties.known_selection_bias: Phase 7 held-out site: selected for landscape diversity after terrain-v4 parameters were frozen; independent AOI review pending.
